'''Dave Nanninga''' won the [[1998 Origins Open]] in Columbus, Ohio.<ref name="list-53912" /> He was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]], qualifying through that Origins open from Naperville, Illinois, United States. He attended the [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]].<ref name="list-53912" /><ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
